## The Ensign Group to Present at the Stephens Annual Investment Conference on November 18, 2026


11/12/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 154 KB](https://s203.q4cdn.com/190017989/files/doc_news/The-Ensign-Group-to-Present-at-the-Stephens-Annual-Investment-Conference-on-November-18-2026-2026.pdf)


SAN JUAN CAPISTRANO, Calif., Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Ensign Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: ENSG), the parent company of the EnsignTM group of companies, which invest in and provide skilled nursing and senior living services, physical, occupational and speech therapies, other rehabilitative and healthcare services, and real estate, announced today that it will participate in the Stephens Annual Investment Conference on November 18, 2026.


Barry Port, Chief Executive Officer, and Chad Keetch, Chief Investment Officer, will review the company's operations, growth strategy and related information at 11:45 a.m. Central Time on November 18, 2026.


A live audio webcast of the presentation will be accessible via website at[https://event.summitcast.com/view/AnJcL7fjsXraGqV8XG6fRL/er5VJpQaEUBEqX7cT93t3m](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=7rQnIx-qMJmmraLIklLqhQdUA9NbGQm6Pa9XpkI9AHAs2217z-HcMiizyiRyNKuBHnU3EJMF63KgqwjGkQEQGixCKtjP3793JnTiUZIyTsuDyZpO8iBbZ6lSZ7-i2K-JZouxRZJW1fkSwJ9TvCj916uP-D1AABnXHmWWt6KOEbts1eJOz_BxHuz1ahdBaL9Q4jH_DixgT5eJmtJH2bB9z8F2gklSngFqS6RzE5g14OO_TXmknORNtM1HoHG01Jx7v7kTe6I-onD6klEVBh7FTFVvIrQNS-rTyfTnct-4tdPNIeC4x97PzIkDfNDUVKNigG09ZAEarF3y-qdjXFRK0XqKs-J2g4lnlMHmnpxvadDDkPupXgyXc2Ej7U_1XIXEn3RN0RsIxbe6QnWj-Ka6U1ed_mGOuTS8AogyE29WQyY=) . The webcast will be recorded and will be available for replay via the website for 90 days following the presentation.


***About Ensign*** **TM**


The Ensign Group, Inc.'s independent subsidiaries provide a broad spectrum of skilled nursing and senior living services, physical, occupational and speech therapies and other rehabilitative and healthcare services at 418 healthcare facilities in Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Idaho, Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, Nevada, Oregon, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Washington and Wisconsin. More information about Ensign is available at[http://www.ensigngroup.net](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=H579Mz1P7-MMLh0fqWsep7GiNf2CJXcJk_U51pPdr8__6w0niB5uPA37v-UhuZg1tIOH2gSejpWCf48u6aOWEdH53ekzbUpFWz8ohVdzO4E=) .
